brief.premise: A focused late-night instrumental that feels warm rather than sleepy.

groove.feel: Steady restrained pulse with syncopated keys

assumptions: The key and melody will be established during composition; they were not supplied.

lyrics.tagged:
[Intro]
[Electric piano motif and soft pulse]

[Main Groove]
[Instrumental]

[Breakdown]
[Drums recede; retain the motif]

[Outro]
[Instrumental fade]

variants.label: Warm instrumental baseline
variants.hypothesis: Keep the motif clear and the groove stable while evaluating texture.
variants.style: Instrumental minimal house with neo-soul electric piano and restrained ambient space. 104 BPM, 4/4, steady quarter-note pulse. Short syncopated electric-piano motif stays foreground over round synth bass, dry drum-machine kick and light hats. Sparse sustained pad tails fill gaps, not the melody. Intimate opening, gradual groove entry, subtractive breakdown, warm return, clean fading outro. Clear low end and close dry keys; no big drop.
variants.exclude: lead vocals, backing vocals, choir, big EDM drops, bluegrass

variants.label: Light tape-grain texture
